algorithm.title: Treatment Approach for the Patient With Acute Mastoiditis.

cell.label: Acute mastoiditis suspected (otalgia, fever, postauricular swelling, tenderness, and/or erythema present).
Hospitalize. Begin IV antibiotic therapy. Monitor for complications.
Is there evidence of complication (subperiosteal abscess, sinus thrombosis, meningitis, labyrinthitis, petrositis, facial nerve palsy)?
Strongly consider imaging screen for occult complications.
Continue IV antibiotics. Monitor for complications.
Refer for myringotomy. Continue IV antibiotics. Monitor for complications.
Obtain appropriate imaging temporal HR-CT to screen for bony opacification, bony destruction, coalescence. Cranial CT with contrast for intracranial complications.
